decisions.reason: Category 172 is an inheritance/Spark description. Recast the sentence so Spark is clearly the subject governing both effects, preserve the runtime newline, use the embedded player-facing stat/Skill Hint terminology, and restore the repository-verified Skill title typography rather than the spaced ASCII-calque form.
